nodes.label: C-SSRS Ideation Severity Levels
nodes.rationale: Highest-numbered endorsed level 0-5 is an ordinal indicator with its time window, not a suicide probability or standalone disposition rule.

nodes.label: C-SSRS Demonstration Triage Flags
nodes.rationale: No-positive, clinical-review, high-risk and emergency flags route recent level 4-5 or recent behavior to immediate assessment without inventing universal score bands.
